summary: Third Coast Bancshares, Inc., a Texas bank holding company trading on the NYSE and NYSE Texas under TCBX, filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 reporting that its board declared a routine quarterly cash dividend of $17.25 per share on its 6.75% Series A Convertible Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock. The dividend is payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on September 30, 2026. No deal terms, advisors, or special-situation mechanics are present; this is an ordinary capital-return declaration for preferred holders, not a special situation, with no risk-arb angle to watch.
